title: Mu: a self-hosted personal agent where the interface is an email address you can write to
description:
Mu is a self-hosted personal agent with an actual address. You can chat through its web app, email a named agent, or expose the same tool catalogue through MCP, HTTP, and the CLI. One Go server covers mail, files, calendars, news, markets, search, and small web apps while letting you bring your own model. SMTP in, IMAP out, MCP for agents. #github #opensource 
https://github.com/micro/mu
